أزدقم (form VIII)
# أَزْدَقِمُ (ʔazdaqimu) /ʔaz.da.qi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# أُزْدَقَمُ (ʔuzdaqamu) /ʔuz.da.qa.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# أَزْدَقِمَ (ʔazdaqima) /ʔaz.da.qi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# أُزْدَقَمَ (ʔuzdaqama) /ʔuz.da.qa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
